s: This article details the integration of LLMs, specifically Claude 3.5 Sonnet and Gemma 2, into a web application to provide ambient intelligence by observing user interactions and eventually automating tasks, while exploring loose coupling via WebSockets and comparing WSGI/ASGI.
sub: Ambient intelligence via LLM user interaction monitoring
Integration of local LLMs (Gemma 2) with frontier models for 'agentic swarming'
Web application development with Python's WSGI vs ASGI for WebSocket support
Refinement of chat interface functionality, including streaming and history persistence
